annotations.title: Get a university or VET Unit

description: Read an exact teaching Unit. For uni, the newest year is the default. When multiple offerings are available, use a returned offeringId to read the selected offering. For vet, use release when reading a historical version. Default to an overview; use sections for the requested original-English content. Null is unavailable in the source. Use the linked website to generate a Course Outline. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

contentVersion.description: Reuse the contentVersion from page 1 for later pages.

id.description: For uni use CRICOS school code and Unit code joined by a hyphen, e.g. 00098G-MGMT3101. For vet use the Unit code.
